sketchMechanisms: Ownership move: passing a non-Copy value by value transfers ownership, and any later use of the old binding is a compile-time error.
Temporal Dead Zone: a block-scoped let binding shadows the outer name from the start of the block, but cannot be read before its declaration executes.
Conditional compilation: code inside #if 0 is removed before the compiler sees it, so later references to it have no declaration to find.
